name: helix-gtm-alpha
description: Review a supplied business challenge with the EPIC method, explain rule based GTM scores and prepare a roadmap for a selected focus and timeframe.

interface.longDescription: Helix GTM Consulting. Review a supplied business challenge with the EPIC method, explain rule based GTM scores and prepare a roadmap for a selected focus and timeframe. This package connects to 3 hosted rule based tools. The server does not run an AI model or perform live company research. It uses your supplied inputs; some outputs are working drafts or include explicitly labelled example assumptions. Review facts, calculations and placeholders before use. It does not connect to your CRM or send emails. Tool inputs are sent to the hosted service; consult its privacy policy for data handling.
defaultPrompt: Review my business challenge using the EPIC method.
Help me compare GTM priorities from my own business inputs.
Prepare a 30 day roadmap for establishing market traction.

positive.prompt:
Use this synthetic review scenario, not a claim about any real company. EPIC input audit. Use these inputs:
{"company_name": "HubSpot", "challenge": "Synthetic scenario: enterprise pipeline is inconsistent, positioning is broad and sales handoffs are unclear. Use only these test inputs.", "industry": "saas", "business_stage": "growth", "acv_usd": 25000, "deal_cycle_days": 60, "nrr_percent": 105, "tam_accounts": 5000, "self_serve": false, "deal_source": "mixed", "geography": "global", "current_channels": "Webinars and partner referrals"}
positive.expected_behavior: Call the named tool with the supplied inputs. Return its relevant analysis, preserve supplied facts and hypothetical labels, identify missing evidence, and do not claim live research or external actions.
